title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. scheuchzeri
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. scheuchzeri, commonly known as Scheuchzer's bellflower, is a plant species in the Campanulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Scheuchzer's bellflower include its potential to act as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
